# MicroBinfie Podcast

> A podcast about microbial bioinformatics and public health genomics, hosted by Lee Katz,
> Andrew Page and Nabil-Fareed Alikhan since 2019. Each episode below has a written overview
> made from its transcript and checked against it: who was on, what was discussed, timestamps,
> quotes, the tools mentioned, and questions the episode answers. Audio is on SoundCloud.

- [All episodes]({{ '/pages/Episodes.html' | absolute_url }}): the full list, newest first
